name: dll-loader-character
summary: Make Character.exe load the companion hook DLL (fiestahook.dll) before its entry point - the same loader Zone.exe gets.
status: BUILT, not yet run against a live Character.
why: The same loader as dll-loader (read that recipe): one import of fiestahook.dll!ZoneHookInit appended to a
copy of the import descriptors, no code patched. Character.exe has no bound-import directory (checked at
apply time) and imports StartServiceCtrlDispatcherA, which is where the loader starts its plugins - from
Character/hooks/, a folder of its own: a zone plugin must never be loaded into Character.
